sourceAssertions: ProfileFencedLlmConversationStore has no post-commit admission callback.
The operation facade does not invoke the old composite conversationEngine.SendAsync path.
Provider invocation is outside the admission and finalization transactions.
No production partial expansion or forbidden project dependency was introduced.

compensation failure cannot produce terminal Failed/Cancelled
ambiguous prior dispatch requires recovery and cannot redispatch
stale transcript revision remains a typed HTTP conflict

acceptance.criterion: Turn admission is one transaction across operation, transcript, evidence, and event state.
acceptance.evidence: PostgreSQL admission failure injection rolls back operation, user entry, active turn, and admission evidence together. Stream-event journal integration is additively owned by SB08.

acceptance.criterion: Successful completion is one transaction across assistant message, usage, active-turn clearing, and operation success.
acceptance.evidence: PostgreSQL success-finalization failure injection removes assistant/result state and preserves the active nonterminal operation.

acceptance.criterion: Failed compensation cannot leave a terminal Failed or Cancelled operation with a live active turn.
acceptance.evidence: Rollback proof plus failed-compensation unit test advances unresolved state to RecoveryRequired.

acceptance.criterion: A cancellation request committed before finalization prevents Succeeded.
acceptance.evidence: Monotonic cancellation generation, locked finalization check, and red/green transition regression.

acceptance.criterion: Same operation ID and fingerprint replays the original result even after later lifecycle changes.
acceptance.evidence: Focused replay-after-archive unit case passes without a second provider dispatch.

acceptance.criterion: Same operation ID with a different fingerprint conflicts before provider dispatch.
acceptance.evidence: Focused idempotency conflict case passes and dispatch count remains unchanged.

acceptance.criterion: Conversation archive cannot race an active or nonterminal turn.
acceptance.evidence: Archive and admission share a conversation row lock; focused active/nonterminal cases reject archive.

acceptance.criterion: Direct completion and recovery reduce identical durable evidence to the same outcome.
acceptance.evidence: LlmChatOperationReducer direct/restart and DeadlineExceeded audit cases pass.
